discovery.sct_primary_rule: Phase-13C SCV10 > 0.0 after the shared non-SCV qualification gate

rounds.round_2: ordinary tasks; counting/grouping variants alternate, including symmetric grids
rounds.round_3: composition training/validation and promotion opportunity; reflection tasks use genuine rotate-then-reflect composed generator
rounds.round_4: held-out composition confirmation plus ordinary tasks; same construction as round 3 with independent task seeds

arms.B2_SKILL_STORAGE_ONLY: persistent skill storage/reuse and existing SkillConfig/skill-lifecycle APIs; only atomic capability proposals from genuinely core/anchored skills, no clustering or composition
arms.A1_NO_IDT: family-specific exact full trace sequences repeated at least three times; no invariant representation
arms.B4_COMPRESSION_PROXY: repeated traces compressed to observed task-operation subsequences; not canonical DreamCoder

growth_config.system_ct_aggregation: mean capability_score over non-archived capabilities; empty portfolio is 0.0
growth_config.component_deltas: round-to-round differences of system mean measured transfer_score across non-provisional skills, portfolio mean CapU, global supported-family coverage (union of successful target families divided by four), and promoted composition-skill count
growth_config.measured_transfer_score: for Phase 13E-created skills, mean observed positive transfer benefit from successful ReuseEngine events; expected transfer priors are retained separately and not used as measured TS
growth_config.system_su_ts_population: all non-provisional skills in the arm library; portfolio CapU remains restricted to capability members
growth_config.experience_count: 32 discovery traces plus cumulative held-out tasks through the current round; identical denominator across arms
growth_config.coverage_reporting: repository portfolio total_coverage plus union of capability-member successful target families divided by four families
growth_config.task_utility: observed task success indicator minus observed reasoning cost / 100; baseline solver when no reuse is applied

composition.task_generator: make_task(compose=True), whose reference operation is rotation followed by reflection

statistics.interval: two-sided Student-t CI across available independent seed-level values using df=n-1; for the complete n=10 block df=9, critical value=2.262157
statistics.paired_comparisons: within-seed differences; same tasks and seed streams across arms
statistics.correlation_unit: within each seed, arithmetic mean of the four round-level values; Pearson r across ten seed-level summaries; descriptive
statistics.capability_value_correlations: EXP-CAP-10/11: per-seed mean accepted capability CapU versus mean member measured TS and mean member reuse count; Pearson r across seeds, descriptive
statistics.correlation_decision: report r, n, and two-sided Fisher-z 95% CI for every preregistered correlation; positive r is directionally supportive only, no significance threshold or causal claim
statistics.future_prediction_pairs: within each seed, C_t at rounds 1-3 paired with mean task utility in rounds 2-4; cluster bootstrap resamples whole seeds, 4000 replicates, RNG seed 87213
statistics.missing_outcomes: retain as null/unavailable with reason; never impute as positive
statistics.regression_probe: in an isolated cloned final ASFT portfolio, remove the lexicographically first measured successful-transfer skill from all memberships; recompute C_t and CGR

preregistered_decisions.capability_emergence_replicated: at least one valid capability persists across at least two consecutive rounds in at least 8 of 10 ASFT seeds
preregistered_decisions.positive_directional_metric: seed-level mean > 0 and two-sided 95% CI lower bound > 0
preregistered_decisions.positive_IE_trend: mean across-seed OLS slope of IE over rounds 1-4 > 0 and 95% CI lower bound > 0
preregistered_decisions.ASFT_beats_baseline: paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 for final C_t and mean held-out task utility across all four rounds; report each baseline separately
preregistered_decisions.ablation_reduces_growth: paired ASFT-minus-ablation CGR 95% CI lower bound > 0 for A1-A4; A5 is measurement-only and must be unavailable
preregistered_decisions.composition_creates_value: positive mean paired composition-vs-best-single task benefit difference and 95% CI lower bound > 0
preregistered_decisions.growth_predicts_future_performance: positive seed-clustered Pearson association between C_t at round t and next-round task utility, with lower 95% CI > 0; if insufficient pairs, unavailable
preregistered_decisions.trajectory_monotonicity: descriptive share of seeds with non-decreasing C_t across all four rounds; do not redefine other criteria
preregistered_decisions.composition_capability_count: descriptive fraction of seeds with round-4 count greater than round-2 count and a successful held-out composition
preregistered_decisions.higher_order_emergence: report accepted emergent capability type count/seed occurrences; unavailable if none; no manual insertion
